subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What reset-greeting policy should OpenClaw support for bare `/new` and `/reset` across chat and Gateway agent paths?
rationale: The remaining work is not just code plumbing: it chooses whether reset should default to a static ack, a model-run greeting, or configurable modes, and that changes session behavior and model routing for existing users.

options.title: Define a unified reset-greeting policy
options.body: Add a typed config shape that covers static acknowledgement, suppressed reply, and optional greeting model behavior across both chat and Gateway reset paths.

options.title: Keep static acknowledgements only
options.body: Document the current v2026.6.11 behavior and close or narrow greeting-restore requests, leaving no model-run greeting config for now.

options.title: Restore model greeting default
options.body: Sponsor the restore-fallthrough direction only with explicit upgrade proof and a policy for users who want to avoid greeting-token spend.

recommendation.title: Define a unified reset-greeting policy
recommendation.body: Add a typed config shape that covers static acknowledgement, suppressed reply, and optional greeting model behavior across both chat and Gateway reset paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue as needing maintainer follow-up and has broad recent history in the affected gateway/session surfaces.
